strings.zh: 你个小东西,{NEWLINE}快点和我{CLEAR}交换下电话号码！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hey, squirt! Hurry up and{NEWLINE}trade phone numbers with me!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 要记得给我打电话！{NEWLINE}我也会给你打的！
strings.en: Call me sometime!{NEWLINE}I’ll call you sometimes, too!{NEWLINE}

strings.zh: 小子,{NEWLINE}这次你是真的{CLEAR}要和我来换号码了？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Kid, you really gonna trade{NEWLINE}numbers with me this time?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哇哈哈！{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}这块觉醒石{CLEAR}我就爽快地送给你吧！{SCROLL}来,给你{SCROLL}⋯⋯没你别的事了,{NEWLINE}你爱去哪就去哪吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Wah ha ha! {VAR:0103:0}! I’ll just give you{NEWLINE}this Dawn Stone, no strings attached!{SCROLL}Here you go.{SCROLL}...Nothing else for you here. Go{NEWLINE}wherever you like!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 在自行车道上{NEWLINE}边骑车边打电话{CLEAR}是很危险的！{SCROLL}你要是在附近{NEWLINE}就直接和我聊天吧！
strings.en: Talking on the phone while riding{NEWLINE}on Cycling Road is dangerous!{SCROLL}If you’re nearby, just{NEWLINE}come talk to me in person!

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}变得老强了！{SCROLL}前几天只用了两秒{NEWLINE}就把{VAR:0100:11}给打趴下了！{CLEAR}哇哈哈哈！！{SCROLL}⋯⋯什么？{NEWLINE}你说我牛皮吹破了？{SCROLL}去你的！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} has{NEWLINE}gotten crazy strong!{SCROLL}The other day it flattened a {VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}in just two seconds! Wahahahaha!!{SCROLL}...What? You think I’m full of it?{SCROLL}Screw you!

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}变得好强好强了！{SCROLL}照这样子,抓获{VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}指日可待！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} has gotten awesomely{NEWLINE}strong!{SCROLL}At this rate, catching {VAR:0100:11} is{NEWLINE}just around the corner!

strings.zh: 我前段时间在路上{NEWLINE}遇到了{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}因为是突然蹿出来的,{NEWLINE}所以我急急忙忙要避开它,{CLEAR}从自行车上摔了下来！{SCROLL}还好只是受了点小伤！{SCROLL}看来我打心底里就不想伤害{NEWLINE}野生精灵啊！
strings.en: Recently, I came across a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} on the road.{SCROLL}Suddenly, out it jumps! I fell off{NEWLINE}my Bike trying not to hit it!{SCROLL}But it’s all good, even though I got a{NEWLINE}little scraped up.{SCROLL}It’s all good ’cause I like to be nice to{NEWLINE}wild Pokémon!

strings.zh: 喂！我现在在{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}！{SCROLL}别躲躲藏藏的了,{NEWLINE}快来和我对战！
strings.en: Hey! Right now, I’m{NEWLINE}on {VAR:0104:3}!{SCROLL}Don’t run, don’t hide, just get over{NEWLINE}here and fight me!

strings.zh: 听好了！我现在在{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}！{SCROLL}你要堂堂正正地{NEWLINE}一个人过来！{SCROLL}⋯⋯不对,{NEWLINE}精灵还是要带的。{CLEAR}不然的话{CLEAR}也打不了了！
strings.en: Listen! Here I wait on good old{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}!{SCROLL}Time for us to have another battle,{NEWLINE}fair and square, so come alone!{SCROLL}Wait...{NEWLINE}Bring your Pokémon with you!{CLEAR}Without a Pokémon, we can’t battle!

strings.zh: 你现在是不是还是{NEWLINE}把精灵溜在身后？{SCROLL}这个⋯⋯{NEWLINE}很享受吧？{SCROLL}像我这样成天骑自行车,{CLEAR}搞得我都不能{CLEAR}带精灵出去溜达了。{SCROLL}老实说,{NEWLINE}我还真有点羡慕你！
strings.en: You...{NEWLINE}You’ve got a Pokémon with you, right?{SCROLL}That’s...{NEWLINE}That’s pretty sweet, isn’t it?{SCROLL}If you were blazing up and down the{NEWLINE}road as fast as you could, like me, you{CLEAR}wouldn’t be able to have your Pokémon{CLEAR}alongside you.{SCROLL}Makes me a bit jealous of you, to tell{NEWLINE}the truth.

strings.zh: 喂！我捡到好东西了！{SCROLL}我找了个识货的人问了一下,{NEWLINE}原来这是觉醒石！{SCROLL}想要的话{NEWLINE}就来{VAR:0104:3}拿吧！
strings.en: Hey! I picked up something great!{SCROLL}I checked it with someone who knows{NEWLINE}this stuff. They said it’s a Dawn Stone.{SCROLL}If you want it, I’m on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}, so come and get it!

strings.zh: 快来拿觉醒石啊！{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: Hurry and come get the Dawn Stone! I’m{NEWLINE}waiting for you on {VAR:0104:3}!
